questions.q: Menene Avana?
questions.a:
Avana tana ba masu samar da ruwan kuɗi damar amfani da matsayin AMM a matsayin jingina a kan Aave V4. Mai aro yana pledge matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum ko matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream a Base. LPVault na Avana yana riƙe da matsayin, kuma ana samar da vault token da ya dace a matsayin jingina a kan Avana CDP Spoke. Sannan mai aro yana aron GHO, ko wata kadarar bashi da Spoke ke bayarwa, yayin da ruwan kuɗin ke zama a cikin pool.

Avana tana ƙaddamarwa a Ethereum da Base, tare da Avana Stable LP Hub a kowane chain. Hubs da Spokes kwangiloli ne na Aave V4 na yau da kullum, da ba a gyara ba, mallakar Aave DAO kuma shi ke saita su. Kwangilolin Avana kanta suna kula da tsarewa, ƙimantawa, ayyukan mai aro da liquidation.

questions.q: Wane matsala Avana ke warwarewa?
questions.a:
Masu samar da ruwan kuɗi galibi dole su cire ruwan kuɗi kafin su iya aro a kansa. Wannan yana nufin barin pool da rasa kuɗin shiga na kuɗaɗe da kewayon da suka zaɓa.

Avana tana sa matsayin LP da ake goyon baya su zama masu amfani a matsayin jingina yayin da suke zama a cikin pool. LPOracle yana ƙimanta kowane matsayi daga adadin tokens ɗinsa a farashin oracle, kuma Aave V4 yana rubuta shi a matsayin vault token. Fa'idar ga LPs sassaucin jari ce, ba tabbataccen riba ba. Masu aro har yanzu suna ɗaukar impermanent loss, haɗarin farashi da haɗarin liquidation.

questions.q: Yaya Avana ta bambanta da kasuwar lamuni ta yau da kullum?
questions.a:
Kasuwannin rance na yau da kullum suna ɗaukar jingina a matsayin ma'aunin tokens. Matsayin LP yana riƙe da tokens da yawa, yana samun kuɗaɗe, yana canza haɗinsa yayin da farashi ke motsawa, zai iya fita daga kewayo, kuma yana buƙatar takamaiman hanya don warwarewa.

Don haka Avana tana saita haɗari ga kowace kasuwa. Kasuwa pool ɗaya ce da ainihin kewayon tick ɗaya a kan CDP Spoke ɗaya, tare da vault token nata, Collateral Factor, iyakoki, hanyar farashi da hanyoyin musanya. Kowane wallet yana da asusu daban ga kowace kasuwa, don haka jinginar kasuwa ɗaya ba ta taɓa tallafa wa bashi a wata kasuwa ba.

questions.q: Waɗanne AMMs ne Avana ke tallafawa?
questions.a:
A lokacin ƙaddamarwa, Avana tana goyon bayan matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream a Base. Dole a cire matsayin Slipstream daga stake; ba za a iya yin pledge da matsayin da aka yi stake a gauge ba. Kowace kasuwa tana karɓar ainihin kewayon tick ɗaya, kuma ana ƙin matsayi mai kowane kewayo daban.

Tushen Avana AMM-neutral ne. An bayyana haɗawa ga Uniswap v2, Curve StableSwap-NG, Balancer da Uniswap v4, amma ana jera kowanne ne kawai bayan binciken shirinsa ya wuce kuma gudanarwa ta amince da shi. An cire pools masu tokens na fee-on-transfer, rebasing ko hook.

questions.q: Shin Avana yana maye gurbin AMM inda kuɗin ruwa na yake?
questions.a:
A'a. AMM har yanzu yana kula da musanya, yanayin pool, motsin farashi da samar da kuɗaɗe. Avana tana ƙara matakin jingina a kewayen matsayin da ake goyon baya.

Lokacin da ka yi pledge da matsayi, LPVault na wannan AMM yana riƙe da NFT, kuma Avana tana mint vault tokens daidai da ruwan kuɗin matsayin. Ruwan kuɗin yana zama a cikin pool kuma yana ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗe yayin da yake cikin kewayo. Za ka iya karɓar waɗannan kuɗaɗe a kowane lokaci.

questions.q: An tura Avana?
questions.a:
Tukuna ba. Takardar bayanin Avana da interfaces na kwangiloli sun cika kuma sun bi ta bita ta cikin gida da yin samfuri na formal. Ana rubuta lambar kwangila a gaba, sannan binciken tsaro masu zaman kansu na kowace kwangila da ƙuri'un Aave DAO da ke amincewa da turawa da kuɗaɗe.

Za a jera adireshin kwangiloli a shafin Contracts na takardun masu haɓakawa da zarar an tura kwangilolin. Sandbox na jama'a a app.avana.cc yana amfani da kadarorin kwaikwayo.

questions.q: Ta yaya Avana ke aiki a babban mataki?
questions.a:
Kana pledge matsayin da ake goyon baya ta AaveAdapter. LPVault yana karɓar tsarewar NFT, Collateralization tana rubuta yawan ruwan kuɗin da yake tallafawa, kuma AaveAdapter yana mint wannan adadin vault tokens ga PositionProxy ɗinka na kasuwar. Proxy yana samar da su a matsayin jingina a kan CDP Spoke na kasuwar. Sannan kana aro ta AaveAdapter, wanda ke bincika farashi, iyakoki da ma'aunin lafiyarka.

Biya, cirewa, cire wani ɓangare na ruwan kuɗi, biya da jingina da karɓar kuɗaɗe suma suna gudana ta AaveAdapter. Liquidation tana gudana ta LPVaultSwap. Kowace haɓakawa ko canjin siga ga kwangilolin Avana tana bi ta AvanaTimelock na chain.

questions.q: Me yasa Avana ke amfani da Aave V4 Hubs da Spokes?
questions.a:
Aave V4 yana raba ruwan kuɗi na tarayya (Hubs) da saitunan haɗari na musamman na kasuwa (Spokes). Kowane chain yana da Avana Stable LP Hub. Aave DAO yana ba shi layin bashin GHO mai iyaka ta Lend Spoke na samarwa kaɗai, kuma CDP Spokes na Avana kaɗai za su iya ɗauka daga gare shi.

Akwai CDP Spoke ɗaya ga kowane chain, Hub, yarjejeniyar AMM da matakin haɗari. A lokacin ƙaddamarwa waɗannan su ne "Uniswap v3 Stable" a Ethereum da "Aerodrome Slipstream Stable" a Base. An ƙera Correlated LP da Volatile LP Hubs don nan gaba. Avana ba ta yin fork ko gyara Aave V4.

questions.q: Menene CDP Spoke?
questions.a:
CDP Spoke Aave V4 Spoke ne na yau da kullum mallakar Aave DAO. Yana riƙe da reserve ɗaya na vault-token na jingina kaɗai ga kowace kasuwar Avana da reserves na bashi da aka kunna masa, GHO na farko. Yana amfani da Collateral Factor, ribar liquidation da iyakokin kowace kasuwa.

Kowane reserve na vault-token yana amfani da saituna uku da ake buƙata: an kashe karɓar hannun jari, kuɗin liquidation na Aave 0 ne (ko ana biyan sa ga mai karɓar kuɗin Avana), kuma ba a saita mai sarrafa sake saka jari ba. Tare da ƙa'idar canja wurin vault token, waɗannan suna sa LPVaultSwap ya zama kwangila ɗaya tilo da za ta iya karɓar jinginar da aka ƙwace.

questions.q: Menene alamun Avana vault?
questions.a:
Vault tokens tokens ne na ERC-20 na jingina kaɗai, ɗaya ga kowace kasuwa. Raka'ar tushe ɗaya daidai take da raka'a ɗaya ta ruwan kuɗin da aka sa a asusu. Ana tsayar da decimals ga kowace kasuwa tsakanin 6 da 18 a jera kasuwa. AaveAdapter kaɗai ke mint da ƙona su, kuma suna motsawa ne kawai tsakanin PositionProxies masu rajista, CDP Spoke da LPVaultSwap.

Vault tokens ba su da kasuwa ta biyu, ba su da fitarwa kuma ba su da farashin musanya. Wadatarsu ba ta taɓa wuce ruwan kuɗin da Collateralization ta sa a asusu tare da duk wasu raka'o'in da ke jiran sasantawa.

questions.q: Menene manyan sassan tsarin Avana?
questions.a:
Tsarewa: LPVault mara canzawa ga kowace yarjejeniyar AMM a kowace chain, da littafin lissafi na Collateralization. Asusu da tokens: VaultToken da VaultTokenFactory, PositionProxy da ProxyManager. Manufa: AaveAdapter (hanyar shiga ta mai aro), RiskModule (bincike), MarketRegistry (kasuwanni, hanyoyi, yanayin dakatarwa, breakers) da ParameterStore (ma'aunan haɗari).

Oracles: LPOracle ga kowace kasuwa da DebtOracle ga kowace kadarar bashi da ba GHO ba. Liquidation: LPVaultSwap, kwangilolin hanyoyin musanya da PayoutEscrow, tare da mataimakin flash liquidation na jama'a na Avana ga masu kira da ba sa riƙe da ko kaɗan na kadarar bashi. Biyan bashi da jingina yana amfani da tushen flash a kan Aave V3 Pool. Kayan more rayuwa: AvanaTimelock, Lock da Lens na karatu kaɗai. Sashen Developers yana jera kowace kwangila a shafinsa na Contracts.

questions.q: Me ke faruwa lokacin da na ajiye jinginar LP?
questions.a:
Kana amincewa da LPVault don NFT na matsayinka kuma kana kiran pledge a kan AaveAdapter. LPVault yana bincika cewa matsayin ya yi daidai da pool da ainihin kewayon kasuwar kuma yana karɓar tsarewa. RiskModule yana bincika yanayin farashi, matsayin kasuwar, mafi ƙanƙantar pledge ($10 a lokacin ƙaddamarwa), iyakokin kasuwa, token da mai ajiya, iyakar kason pool, iyakar rikodi 16 ga kowane asusu da kasuwa, da duk wani breaker.

Idan binciken ya wuce, AaveAdapter yana tura PositionProxy ɗinka na kasuwar idan ana buƙata, yana mint vault tokens daidai da ruwan kuɗin da aka sa a asusu kuma yana samar da su a matsayin jingina. Pledge ba ya aron komai. Babu jerin izini kuma babu mafi girman girman matsayi fiye da iyakoki.

questions.q: Shin matsayin LP na zai ci gaba da aiki bayan ajiya?
questions.a:
Eh. Pledge yana canza tsarewa amma ba ya cire ruwan kuɗi. Pool yana ci gaba da sarrafa musanya kuma matsayinka yana ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗe. Matsayi mai taruwa yana daina samun kuɗaɗe yayin da yake wajen kewayo.

Za ka iya ƙara ruwan kuɗi ga NFT da aka yi pledge da shi kuma ka sa shi a asusu da recredit, cire wani ɓangare na ruwan kuɗin yayin da NFT ke zama a pledge da removeLiquidity, ko ƙara jingina da wani matsayi a kasuwa ɗaya.

questions.q: Shin zan iya karɓar kuɗin LP yayin da nake aro?
questions.a:
Eh. Mai ajiya zai iya kiran collectFees a kan AaveAdapter a kowane lokaci. AMM yana biyan kuɗaɗen kai tsaye gare ka. Karɓar kuɗaɗe ba ya canza vault tokens ɗinka, iyakoki, bashi ko ma'aunin lafiya.

Babu dakatarwa, daskarewa, breaker ko yanayin farashi da ke toshe karɓar kuɗaɗe. A Base kuma yana aiki yayin katsewar sequencer ta tilasta shigarwa daga L1.

questions.q: Shin kudaden LP suna cikin ƙimar jingina?
questions.a:
A'a. LPOracle yana ƙimanta ruwan kuɗin da ke bayan kowane vault token kaɗai. An cire kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba daga farashin, kuma liquidation ba ta taɓa ƙwace su ba.

Iyakokin aro suna fitowa daga Collateral Factor na kasuwar, da ake amfani da shi daban. Ƙimar oracle kanta ba ta da ragi.

questions.q: Yaushe zan iya janye jinginar LP?
questions.a:
Idan babu bashi, za ka iya cirewa a kowane lokaci, kuma babu dakatarwa, daskarewa, breaker ko yanayin farashi da ke toshe shi. repayAllAndWithdraw yana biyan kowane bashi kuma yana mayar da matsayin a kira ɗaya.

Idan akwai bashi, cirewa tana buƙatar Hub kada ya kasance a dakatar (Hub da aka daskarar har yanzu yana ba da izini), adireshinka kada ya kasance a daskare, farashin Live, sequencer mai aiki a Base, babu breaker da ya kunna, da ma'aunin lafiya a ko sama da mafi ƙanƙantar da ka zaɓa bayan haka. LPVault yana mayar da NFT tare da kuɗaɗensa da ba a karɓa ba.

questions.q: Matsayi nawa asusu ɗaya zai iya riƙewa?
questions.a:
Kowane wallet yana da PositionProxy ɗaya, don haka asusun Aave ɗaya, ga kowane CDP Spoke da kasuwa. Asusu yana riƙe da rikodin tallafi 16 a mafi yawa na kasuwarsa. Matsayi a wata kasuwa yana buɗe asusu daban tare da ma'aunin lafiyarsa.

Idan aka yi liquidation ga asusu, Collateralization tana ƙwace rikodinsa daga mafi girma.

questions.q: Yaya Avana ke ƙayyade farashin jinginar LP?
questions.a:
LPOracle yana ƙimanta farashin kowane vault token ta haɗin gaskiya: yana lissafa adadin tokens da ke bayan raka'a ɗaya ta ruwan kuɗi a rabon farashin oracle, da aka takaita a cikin kewayon kasuwar, kuma yana ninka su da farashin USD na Chainlink. Ana zagaye adadi ƙasa kuma an cire kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba. Farashi suna da decimals 8, kuma oracle ba ya taɓa komawa baya kuma ba ya taɓa mayar da 0.

Ana ƙimanta bashin GHO a tsayayyen $1. Ana ƙimanta sauran kadarorin bashi ta DebtOracle nasu.

questions.q: Yaya Avana ke sarrafa gazawar oracle?
questions.a:
Kowane token yana da babbar hanya da madadin hanyar Chainlink da hanyar jiran aiki da aka riga aka amince da ita. Dole farashi su zama sababbi a cikin heartbeat na feed tare da tazara. Aro kuma yana buƙatar tushe na biyu mai zaman kansa ya yarda, binciken daidaiton TWAP na pool, da stablecoins a cikin iyakar $0.90–$1.02.

Farashin kowace kasuwa yana cikin ɗaya daga cikin yanayi huɗu: Live, Drifting, Cached ko Expired. Cached (har zuwa awa 1) da Expired suna toshe sabon aro da liquidation na wannan kasuwa. Expired yana ƙimanta jinginar a kusan sifili yayin da biya da fita ba tare da bashi ba ke ci gaba. Bayan dawowa, lokacin alheri na mintuna 30 yana ba da izinin liquidation ne kawai ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya na 0.95.

questions.q: Shin Avana yana rage darajar baka?
questions.a:
A'a. Oracle yana ba da rahoton ƙima ba tare da ragi ba. Collateral Factor na kowace kasuwa yana saita yawan wannan ƙima da zai iya tallafa wa bashi: Collateral Factor mafi ƙanƙanta na Aave V4 a cikin tokens na pool da aka ninka da ma'aunin haɗarin pool na 40% a mafi yawa. Hanyar GHO tana amfani da bayyanannen factor da aka saita a jera kasuwa.

Nazarin Gauntlet na jinginar LP yana ba da shawarar factors na farawa masu taka-tsantsan, har zuwa ƙasa da 0.25× na factor mafi ƙanƙanta na ƙasa lokacin da kadarar da aka aro ba ɗaya daga cikin tokens na pool ba ce. Ana daidaita factors na ƙarshe ga kowace kasuwa tare da masu ba da sabis na Aave.

questions.q: Me ya sa ake kula da matsayin tsarin mai yawa na ruwa da kyau?
questions.a:
Matsayi mai taruwa yana canza haɗinsa da sauri yayin da farashi ke motsawa kuma zai iya fita daga kewayo. Don haka Avana tana jera kowane ainihin kewayo a matsayin kasuwarsa, tana ƙimanta shi tare da takaita kewayon, kuma tana saita ma'aunin haɗarin pool gare shi.

LPVault yana ƙin matsayin da kewayonsa ya bambanta da na kasuwar, kuma LPOracle yana bincika yanayin pool a kan TWAP kafin aro.

questions.q: Wadanne bayanan kasuwa ne Avana ke lura da su?
questions.a:
Keeper da sa idon Avana suna bin yanayin farashi, kason pool, zurfin pool, ƙwacewa, gazawar hanyar musanya, gibi da saitin Aave na kowane reserve. Wasu yanayi suna kunna breakers a kan chain; wasu suna tayar da faɗakarwa, kamar faɗuwar farashi ta 3% cikin awanni 2, fiye da 20% na kasuwa da aka ƙwace cikin awa 1, gazawar hanyar musanya 3 cikin awa 1, ko Avana tana riƙe da fiye da 25% na pool.

Avana Labs tana wallafa rahotannin amfani na mako-mako da rahotannin kuɗin shiga na wata-wata da ke rufe bashi da jingina bisa kasuwa, taruwa, ma'aunin lafiya, liquidations, amfani da Avana Umbrella, mummunan bashi, lamuran oracle, dakatarwa da kunna breaker, amfani da layin bashi da kuɗaɗe.

questions.q: Yaya aro ke aiki a Avana?
questions.a:
Kana kiran borrow a AaveAdapter da kasuwa, reserve na bashi, adadi, ƙarshen lokaci, mafi ƙanƙantar ma'aunin lafiya da kake karɓa da nonce da kake tsammani. RiskModule yana bincika farashi Live, sabuntar farashin bashi, breakers, yanayin dakatarwa da cewa aƙalla operator mai alƙawari ɗaya yana aiki a chain. PositionProxy ɗinka yana aro a CDP Spoke kuma ana aika maka kuɗin.

Riba tana taruwa a ƙimar tushe ta Hub × (1 + ƙarin ribar haɗarinka), don haka ma'aunin lafiyarka zai iya canzawa ko da jinginarka ba ta canza ba.

questions.q: Yaya ake ƙididdige ƙarfin aron kudi?
questions.a:
Ƙarfin aro = ƙimar matsayin LP × LP Collateral Factor, kuma LP Collateral Factor = Collateral Factor na token mafi ƙanƙanta × ma'aunin haɗarin pool. Ƙarfi kuma ya dogara da bashin da ake da shi, iyakoki, ruwan kuɗin da ke akwai na layin bashi da binciken oracle.

Ƙimomin misali: matsayin USDC/USDT na Slipstream da ya kai $20,000 tare da Collateral Factor na 31.20% yana ba da jingina mai nauyi ta $6,240. Lens yana ba da shawarar aro har zuwa ma'aunin lafiya na 1.10 (5,673.29 USDC a nan) kuma yana nuna mafi yawa a 1.00 (6,209.56 USDC).

questions.q: Me ya sa ƙarfin aron ya ƙasa da ƙimar LP nawa?
questions.a:
Collateral Factor yana barin sarari don motsin farashi, impermanent loss, canje-canjen kewayo da kuɗaɗen liquidation. An iyakance ma'aunin haɗarin pool a 40%, don haka tare da tokens biyu a 78% loan-to-value na buɗewa yana kusan 28.4% a mafi yawa.

Tazarar da ke tsakanin ƙima da ƙarfi ta bambanta tsakanin kasuwanni saboda kowace kasuwa tana da ma'aunin haɗarin pool nata.

questions.q: Waɗanne kadarorin zan iya aro?
questions.a:
GHO ita ce kadarar bashi ta farko a kowane CDP Spoke. Ana iya kunna sauran kadarori, kamar USDC, USDT ko WETH, a matsayin reserves na bashi a kan CDP Spoke ta gudanarwa, kowacce da layin bashinta ke ba da kuɗinta kuma DebtOracle nata ke ƙimanta farashinta.

A lokacin ƙaddamarwa layin bashi GHO ne daga Aave DAO: GHO 2M da aka gabatar a Ethereum, tare da layin Base da aka saita a cikin shawarar kuɗi.

questions.q: Shin zan iya aro akan matsayi da dama na LP a lokaci guda?
questions.a:
A cikin kasuwa ɗaya, eh: har zuwa matsayi 16 suna tallafa wa asusu ɗaya da ma'aunin lafiya ɗaya. Matsayi a kasuwanni daban-daban asusu ne daban, kowanne tare da ma'aunin lafiyarsa, don haka ba sa tallafa wa juna.

A cikin asusu za ka iya aron kadarar bashi fiye da ɗaya idan CDP Spoke yana ba da rancensu.

questions.q: Akwai mafi ƙanƙantar ma'aunin lafiya don aro?
questions.a:
A kan chain, iyaka ɗaya tilo ita ce ma'aunin lafiya na 1.00 na Aave. Kiran borrow yana ɗaukar mafi ƙanƙantar ma'aunin lafiyarka kuma yana komawa baya ƙasa da shi. Lens yana ba da shawarar zama a ko sama da 1.10.

Babu mafi ƙanƙantar bashi. Akwai tsayayyen mafi ƙanƙantar lafiya na kowace kasuwa amma a kashe yake a lokacin ƙaddamarwa.

questions.q: Wa ke samar da ruwan kuɗin da masu aro na Avana ke amfani da shi?
questions.a:
A lokacin ƙaddamarwa, baitulmalin Aave DAO yana samar da layin bashin GHO mai iyaka ga Avana Stable LP Hub na kowane chain ta Lend Spoke na samarwa kaɗai. Ajiya ta jama'a ba a buɗe take ba a lokacin ƙaddamarwa.

Aave DAO ne ke saita iyakar ɗauka na kowane CDP Spoke a kan kadara, kuma jimillar iyakokin ɗauka ba ta wuce layin bashi ba.

questions.q: Daga ina ake samun amfanin mai kaya?
questions.a:
Masu aro suna biyan ƙimar tushe ta Hub tare da risk premium ɗinsu. Ƙimar GHO ta Avana Hub tsayayya ce, ba ta dogara da amfani ba, kuma Aave DAO ne ke saita ta a ko sama da ƙimar tushe ta GHO na Core Hub.

Dukan riba a kan layukan bashi da Aave DAO ke ba da kuɗinsu tana zuwa ga Aave DAO. Avana ba ta cajin kuɗi a kan ribar aro.

questions.q: Masu samarwa suna sarrafa jinginar LP da kansu?
questions.a: A'a. Masu samarwa ba sa zaɓar kewayo ko sarrafa sasantawa. CDP Spokes, kwangilolin tsarewa na Avana da LPVaultSwap suna kula da ƙimantawa, binciken lafiya da liquidation.

questions.q: Menene ke kare babban jarin mai bayar da aron kudi?
questions.a:
Collateral Factors na kowace kasuwa tare da ma'aunin haɗarin pool da bai wuce 40% ba, iyakokin kasuwa, token da mai ajiya ga kowane Hub, yanayin oracle da breakers, liquidation a buɗe ga kowane adireshi tare da keeper na Avana, da iyakokin cirowa da ke zama cikin ruwan kuɗin flash na chain don a iya yi wa kowane aro liquidation a ma'amala ɗaya.

Idan liquidation ta bar bashi ba tare da jingina ba, Avana Umbrella na waccan Hub da kadara yana rufe gibin, reserve na asarar farko da Avana Labs ke ɗaukar nauyinsa kuma Aave DAO ke sarrafawa, cikin awanni 72. Gibin da ya fi reserve girma asara ce ga masu ba da kadarar waccan Hub, wadda Aave DAO ke tabbatarwa.

questions.q: Mene ne ma'aunin lafiya?
questions.a:
Ma'aunin lafiya = ƙimar jingina × Collateral Factor ÷ ƙimar bashi, wanda Aave ke lissafawa ga kowane asusu, wato ga kowace kasuwa. Ƙasa da 1, ana iya yin liquidation ga asusun.

Ƙimomin misali: jingina mai nauyi ta $6,240 a kan bashin USDC 4,999.50 yana ba da ma'aunin lafiya na 1.2481.

questions.q: Me ke shafar lafiyata?
questions.a:
Farashin jingina, haɗin matsayin a cikin kewayonsa, riba a kan bashinka, farashin kadarar bashi, da canje-canjen gudanarwa ga Collateral Factor. Yayin offboarding na kasuwa, iyakar liquidation ɗinta tana faɗuwa sau ɗaya a rana na kwanaki 30.

Biya, ƙara jingina ko biya da jingina suna ɗaga shi. Aro, cirewa ko cire ruwan kuɗi suna rage shi.

questions.q: Yaya ake gudanar da sulhun kudi a Avana?
questions.a:
Lokacin da ma'aunin lafiyar asusu ke ƙasa da 1, kowane adireshi zai iya kiran liquidate a LPVaultSwap. A ma'amala ɗaya LPVaultSwap yana karɓar kadarar bashi daga mai kira, yana kiran liquidationCall na Aave don biyan wani ɓangare na bashin kuma ya karɓi vault tokens tare da karin, yana warware ruwan kuɗin da ya dace kuma yana musanya tokens zuwa kadarar bashi a tsayayyun hanyoyi. Mai kira ba tare da kadarar bashi ba zai iya amfani da mataimakin flash liquidation na jama'a na Avana, wanda ke aron ta ta flash daga Aave V3 Pool na chain kuma yana biyan lamunin daga biyan mai kira.

Kowace liquidation ta ɓangare ce kuma dokokin Aave ne ke auna girmanta. Adadin da aka dawo da shi dole ne ya kai matakin ƙasa da aka samo daga oracle. Ana biyan kuɗin Avana da duk wata rarar mai aro da farko; mai kiran yana karɓar sauran: kuɗinsa da ba a yi amfani da su ba, babban kuɗin da aka dawo da shi da ladarsa, ana biya kai tsaye ko liquidation ta revert.

questions.q: Wanene zai iya warware matsayi mai rashin lafiya?
questions.a:
Kowane adireshi da ba a daskarar ba zai iya kiran liquidate, hanyar shiga ɗaya tilo ta liquidation ta LPVaultSwap, da hanyoyin musanya primary-then-backup ko backup-only. Mai kiran yana ɗaukar nauyin kadarar bashi da kansa ko ta mataimakin flash liquidation na jama'a na Avana, kuma yana biyan duk wani gibi ƙasa da matakin ƙasa na dawowa har zuwa iyakar da ya tsayar. Keeper na Avana shi ne operator mai alƙawari a kowace chain: yana yin alƙawarin yi wa kowane asusu da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 1 liquidation, amma rajista ba ta ba shi wani iko da kowane mai kira ba shi da shi.

Kowa kuma zai iya kiran settlePending don sasanta vault tokens da ƙwacewar da ba a kammala ba ta bari; kuɗin da aka samu suna zuwa Avana Umbrella kuma mai kiran ba ya karɓar komai.

questions.q: Wadanne kudade ne ake bi yayin rushewa?
questions.a:
Kuɗin Avana 20% ne na ribar oracle (ƙimar jinginar da aka ƙwace a farashin oracle ban da bashin da aka biya), wanda aka iyakance ga abin da liquidation ta samu a zahiri. Mai liquidation yana karɓar sauran ribar oracle. Dawowa sama da ƙimar oracle yana zuwa ga mai aro. Mai liquidation da ke aro ta mataimakin flash liquidation yana biyan duk wani flash premium daga biyansa.

Ba a taɓa ɗaukar kuɗaɗen LP ɗinka da ba a karɓa ba. Biyan bashi da jingina ba ya biyan kari ko kuɗin Avana, sai flash premium kaɗai.

questions.q: Me zai iya tsayar da liquidation?
questions.a:
Dakatarwa, daskarewa da breakers ba sa taɓa tsayar da liquidation. Liquidation tana buƙatar farashi mai amfani: farashin Cached ko Expired suna toshe ta, kuma na mintuna 30 bayan dawowar farashi ko sake farawar sequencer na Base, asusun da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya na 0.95 kaɗai za a iya liquidation.

Liquidation kuma tana komawa baya idan hanyoyin musanya ba za su iya kaiwa mafi ƙanƙantar dawowa ba kuma mai kira bai rufe gibin ba. Dakatarwar reserve ta ɓangaren Aave ma za ta iya toshe ta.

questions.q: Yaya ake ƙara sabbin kasuwannin LP?
questions.a:
Avana Labs tana gabatar da kasuwanni da sigogi don tantancewa ta mai bitar haɗari da aka naɗa. Ana jera kowace kasuwa ta AvanaTimelock na chain a jinkiri na yau da kullum, bitar jama'a ta kwanaki biyar da ake tilastawa a kan chain, tare da payload na jera kasuwa na Aave DAO don Collateral Factor, riba da iyakoki.

Pool yana buƙatar ingantaccen farashi na waje, isasshen tarihin ruwan kuɗi, hanyoyin da za su iya dawo da abin da aka samu daga liquidation ƙarƙashin matsi, kuma babu takurawa a kan cire ruwan kuɗi.

questions.q: Shin sigogin haɗari na iya canzawa a tsawon lokaci?
questions.a:
Eh, ta AvanaTimelock. Canje-canjen da ke sassauta haɗari suna jira jinkiri na yau da kullum na kwanaki 5 kuma suna da iyaka: iyakar USD za ta iya tashi 50% a mafi yawa kuma izinin slippage 25 bps a mafi yawa a kowane jinkiri. Canje-canjen da ke rage haɗari kaɗai za su iya amfani da gajeren jinkiri na awanni 12.

Emergency Guardian da Aave Protocol Guardian za su iya dakatarwa ko daskarar da Hub, daskarar da adireshi, kunna breaker ko canjawa zuwa hanyar farashi ta jiran aiki nan take, amma ba za su iya haɓaka kwangiloli, canza sigogi ko motsa kuɗaɗe ba. Aave DAO kuma zai iya daskarewa ko dakatar da reserves na Avana a ɓangaren Aave.

questions.q: A ina zan bi tattaunawar gudanarwa?
questions.a:
Ana tattauna Avana a dandalin gudanarwar Aave (governance.aave.com). ARFC yana zuwa ƙuri'ar Snapshot, sannan ARFC na turawa da ARFC na kuɗi, sannan AIPs.

Avana Labs kuma tana wallafa sabbin bayanai a X a https://twitter.com/avana_labs.

questions.q: Yaya Avana Labs ke samun kuɗin shiga?
questions.a:
Avana Labs tana samun 20% na ribar oracle a kowace liquidation, da avanaFeeShareBps ke saitawa kuma ake canzawa ta timelock kaɗai, da kuɗin app da app ɗinta ke cajin a wajen kwangiloli. Babu kwangilar da ke lissafa ko tilasta kuɗin app, don haka kiran kwangiloli kai tsaye ba ya biyan sa.

Avana ba ta cajin kuɗi a kan ribar aro. Riba a kan layukan bashi na Aave DAO tana zuwa ga DAO.

questions.q: Zan iya aro GHO ta hanyar Avana?
questions.a:
Eh. GHO ita ce kadarar bashi ta farko a kowane CDP Spoke, wadda layin bashi mai iyaka na Aave DAO ga Avana Stable LP Hub ke ba da kuɗinta. Ana ƙimanta bashin GHO a tsayayyen $1.

Bashin GHO yana tara riba a ƙimar GHO ta Hub tare da risk premium ɗinka. Dukan wannan riba tana zuwa ga Aave DAO.

questions.q: Shin GHO na iya zama wani ɓangare na jinginar LP?
questions.a: Eh. Ana iya jera pool na stablecoin da ke ɗauke da GHO. Hanyar GHO ɗinsa tana amfani da bayyanannen Collateral Factor da aka saita a jera kasuwa maimakon factor na Aave V4 Core Hub.

questions.q: Yaya zan biya bashin GHO?
questions.a:
Kira repay a kan AaveAdapter, ko ka bar kowa ya biya a madadinka. Saita repayAll don biyan cikakken bashin a lokacin shigarwa; duk wani adadi da ba a yi amfani da shi ba har zuwa iyakar kashewarka ana mayar da shi. Babu dakatarwar Avana, breaker, daskarewa, farashi ko yanayin sequencer da ke toshe biya; dakatarwar reserve ta ɓangaren Aave kaɗai za ta iya.

Za ka iya kuma biya da jingina: LPVaultSwap yana flash-borrow kadarar bashi, yana biyan ta, yana warware wani ɓangare na matsayinka kuma yana musanya shi don rufe rancen. Bayan cikakken biya, za ka iya cire matsayin.

questions.q: Menene Avana Multiply?
questions.a:
Multiply tsari ne a cikin sandbox na jama'a na Avana a app.avana.cc. A cikin tsarin aiki ɗaya, yana aro a kan jinginar LP kuma yana sake saka kuɗaɗen da aka aro don ƙara fallasa. Sandbox yana amfani da kadarorin kwaikwayo kuma ba ya yin ma'amaloli a kan chain.

Multiply ba ɓangare ba ne na kasuwannin Aave V4 na Avana, waɗanda ke rufe aro a kan matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream a Base.

questions.q: Ta yaya Multiply ya bambanta da aron?
questions.a:
Aro yana ba ku kadarorin da za ku iya amfani da su kai tsaye muddin asusun yana cikin ƙoshin lafiya. Multiply yana amfani da ƙarfin aro mai goyon bayan LP a cikin dabarun da ake gudanarwa. Jarin da aka aro yana shiga cikin fallasa da aka amince da ita kuma ana bibiyarsa a matsayin matsayi ɗaya.

Multiply yana ƙara leverage. Leverage yana ƙara ingancin amfani da jari da yuwuwar riba, amma kuma yana ƙara asara idan farashi ya faɗi, haɗarin liquidation, da tasirin motsin farashi. Bin diddigin lafiyar asusu ya fi muhimmanci, ba ƙasa ba, idan aka maimaita aro a kan matsayi (loop).

questions.q: Shin zan ci gaba da riƙe LP na yayin amfani da Multiply?
questions.a:
Ee. Matsayin LP yana ci gaba da zama tushen jingina yayin da matsayin Multiply ke buɗe. Ba kwa buƙatar fita daga matsayin AMM don samar da fallasa mai leverage.

Matsayin LP har yanzu yana tallafa wa bashi, don haka ƙa'idojin jingina suna aiki, kuma ana iya yi masa liquidation idan asusun ya zama mara lafiya. Masu amfani suna sa ido kan ƙimar jingina, bashi, leverage, da rarar tsaron liquidation muddin loop ɗin yana buɗe.

questions.q: Menene ke iyakance mafi girman amfani da rance?
questions.a:
Mafi girman leverage ya dogara ne da ingancin jingina, ruwan kuɗin pool, sauyin farashi, amincewa da oracle, kadarar aro, iyakokin kasuwa, da zaton liquidation. Pools na stable ko masu tafiya tare sosai yawanci suna tallafa wa iyakokin leverage daban da pools masu sauyin farashi ko marasa zurfi.

Avana yana amfani da matakan sarrafa haɗari na musamman ga kowace kasuwa. Ana taƙaita leverage ne bisa ainihin jinginar LP da ke bayan matsayin, ba bisa ninkawa iri ɗaya da ake aiwatarwa ga kowane pool ba.

questions.q: Shin atomatik na iya taimakawa wajen sarrafa haɗarin matsayi?
questions.a:
Sandbox yana nuna samfoti na aiki ta atomatik da ke sa ido a kan lafiyar asusu kuma yana kunna ayyuka kamar biya ko rage bashi kafin liquidation. Aiki ta atomatik ba ɓangare ba ne na kasuwannin Aave V4 na Avana, amma kowane sabis da ka ba da izini ya aika ma'amala zai iya kiran biya da biya da jingina.

Aiki ta atomatik kayan aikin sarrafa haɗari ne, ba tabbaci ba. Motsin kasuwa, yanayin ruwan kuɗi, jinkirin ma'amala, sabunta oracle, da samuwar hanya har yanzu za su iya shafar aiwatarwa.

questions.q: Shin jinginar LP na iya tallafawa irin haɗarin perps?
questions.a:
A'a. Avana tana rufe aro a kan matsayin Uniswap v3 da aka amince da su a Ethereum da matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream a Base.

Kai ne ke yanke shawarar yadda za ka yi amfani da kadarorin da ka aro, amma Avana ba ta karkatar da bashi mai goyon bayan LP zuwa perps ko wasu dabaru.

questions.q: Me masu amfani ke sa ido a kai bayan buɗe matsayi?
questions.a:
Masu aro suna sa ido a kan ma'aunin lafiya, bashi, ƙimar jingina, ƙimar aro, matsayin kewayo, yanayin farashin kasuwa da nisa zuwa liquidation. Lens yana bayyana waɗannan ƙimomi, har da adadin aro da aka ba da shawara da mafi yawa da sarari a iyaka.

A tsarin Multiply na sandbox, masu amfani kuma suna ganin matakin leverage da ikon warwarewa.
